questions.question: 实际发运数量合计最高的产品名称是什么？
questions.SQL: SELECT p."prod_name" FROM "fact_shipment_line" f JOIN "dim_product" p ON f."prod_id" = p."prod_id" GROUP BY p."prod_id", p."prod_name" ORDER BY SUM(f."actual_quantity") DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: 每个审批人分别审批了多少条能源计量读数？
questions.SQL: SELECT "approved_by", COUNT(*) FROM "fact_energy_meter_reading" GROUP BY "approved_by"

questions.question: 制造商为“示例机械F”的设备，其相关固定资产发生的调拨次数是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_fixed_asset_transfer" f JOIN "dim_fixed_asset" p ON f."asset_id" = p."asset_id" JOIN "dim_equipment" q ON p."equipment_id" = q."equipment_id" WHERE q."manufacturer" = '示例机械F'

questions.question: 按维修备注统计，每个备注对应多少条维修任务？
questions.SQL: SELECT "remarks", COUNT(*) FROM "fact_maintenance_task" GROUP BY "remarks"

questions.question: 2026年备注为“跨月处理”的供应计划一共有多少条？

questions.question: 数据质量分合计最高的原材料名称是什么？
